svg.text: ⚡ CloudPulse Live Platform Lifecycle • Automated GitOps & FinOps Loop

g.text: 🛡️ Step 1: Pre-Merge IaC Security & FinOps Cost Guard
GitHub Actions verifies Terraform syntax, scans for vulnerabilities with Trivy, and enforces the $250/mo budget limit.
[PASS] 0 syntax drift, clean terraform fmt & validate
Pipeline #184: All 4 quality gates green • Commit 3f24a7d • Runtime: 38s
🔄 Step 2: Argo CD GitOps Continuous Reconciliation
Argo CD watches k8s/base/ on branch main. Self-Heal and Auto-Prune keep cluster state 100% matched to Git.
GitOps Policy: selfHeal: true • prune: true • Destination: https://kubernetes.default.svc (cloudpulse)
⚡ Step 3: Kubernetes HPA Dynamic Surge Auto-Scaling
Flash-sale simulated surge triggers CPU utilization spike (78% vs. 60% target) -> HPA rapidly scales pods 2 -> 6.
Throughput surged to 300 req/sec • CPU at 78% (Threshold: 60%)
kubectl get hpa: MINPODS: 2 • MAXPODS: 6 • REPLICAS: 6 • Health: 0 Restarts • Probes: /healthz 200 OK
📊 Step 4: Real-Time Grafana Telemetry & SLI Metrics
Prometheus scrapes pod annotations on :8000/metrics. Grafana visualizes throughput rate, p99 latency, and health.
Prometheus Target: UP • Scrape Interval: 10s • Grafana Dashboard: cloudpulse-prod-telemetry • 0 alerts firing
CloudPulse Enterprise GitOps Platform • AWS EKS v1.31 + Argo CD v3.5 + HPA + Prometheus/Grafana Stack
